timestamp.description: Bucket START instant, epoch ms UTC

value.description: This asset's held quantity across the workspace × price at this point

costBasis.description: This asset's accumulated cost basis across the workspace at this point

granularity.description: Actual spacing of the returned points. '5m' only for range=1H (its own 5-minute CMC grid); '1h'/'1d' for every other range.

currency.description: The workspace's base currency the values are denominated in
